description.desc_thousand_char: Kapco International Limited (KIL) is engaged in manufacturing and exporting of essential oils, fragrances, and flavors. The company’s essential oils include ajowan oil, jasmine absolute, ashwagandha oil, jamarosa oil, anise oil,    angelica root oil, juniper leaf oil, ambrette seed oil and tea tree oil, among others. KIL’s carrier oils and base oils include almond oil sweet, jojoba oil colorless, apricot kernel oil, lin/ flax seed oil, avocado oil and macadamia nut oil, among others. The company’s flower oils include carnation, lotus, muguet, chypre, orchid, gardenia, osmanthus, champca and tulip, among others. KIL’s clientele includes perfumery, SPA, Ayurveda, cosmetics, flavor, candle, potpourri, pharmaceutical, detergent, incense stick and dhoop, tobacco and pan masala. The company’s manufacturing plant and an office is located in Himachal Pradesh.
